name: Arcane Lightning
description: <c=@abilitytype>Arcane</c> skills grant increased ferocity and have additional effects.

facts.description: Incoming strike damage decreased by 33%; stacks duration.

prefix.description: <c=@abilitytype>Arcane.</c> Blast the area, hitting foes with critical damage and healing yourself. Healing effectiveness is increased per target hit. If this skill finishes a combo, you heal an additional amount.
<c=@abilitytype>Arcane.</c> Blast foes in the target area with an energy wave for critical damage.

facts.description: Next outgoing attack misses; stacks duration.

prefix.description: <c=@abilitytype>Arcane.</c> Blast your foe with energy for critical damage.

facts.description: Cannot be knocked down, pushed back, pulled, launched, stunned, dazed, floated, sunk, feared, or taunted.

prefix.description: <c=@abilitytype>Arcane.</c> Block attacks with an energy shield. If it blocks three attacks, it explodes for critical damage.
<c=@abilitytype>Arcane.</c> The next weapon skill you use has significantly reduced recharge, and this skill's recharge is increased by the original recharge of the affected skill.
